packs.name: Lunar
packs.description: Lunar's own colours in light and dark (near-black, white, its grey page and white cards), round corners, a plain header and filled cards. On the intro, Apply for new account filled and Log in with MitID under it in its quieter tone, where the app draws them, the latter said to use another app; the account choice named in the app's own words its header does not say; the country list as a list.

packs.name: Snapchat
packs.description: The chat list: each chat as one item you can open, with its name, status and initials; Map, Chat, Camera, Stories and Spotlight as tabs. A chat: who wrote what, the pictures in it, and a field that sends with Enter. Snapchat ignores some taps and scrolls Relaid sends, so the pack asks to touch the screen there, and to show a chat's pictures.

packs.name: Steam
packs.description: Steam's own dark look in both colour schemes (its slate page, darker boxes, light grey words and blue button), small corners, a plain header and filled cards; on the sign-in screen, Sign in as the main action and the account name and password fields named.

packs.name: Rejseplan
packs.description: Rejseplan's colours in light and dark (its navy, light grey and dark text), round corners, a plain header and outlined cards; the welcome and the getting-started steps named, with Continue filled where the app draws it, as the app fills it.

packs.name: MobilePay
packs.description: MobilePay's colours in light and dark; Send and Request as actions; Home, Payments, Groups, Wallet as tabs with icons; contacts with initials; the amount large and centred; labelled search and amount fields; the PIN lock marked secure, with four dots for the code; the swipe-to-send as a slide you must drag, in MobilePay's own words.

packs.name: DMI
packs.description: DMI's own colours: its blue page, navy bars and white text in light and dark, round corners and flat rows; Vejr, Kort & Radar, Målinger, Varsler and Indstillinger as tabs with icons; the arrows between locations named in Danish where they stand; the search field in the app's own words; section headings, Varsler's info in the menu, the settings as a list.

packs.name: DSB
packs.description: DSB's light greys, white cards and dark text, with its own red as the accent (a destructive control keeps Relaid's mark), in light and dark; small corners, a plain header and outlined cards. Start, Your trips, Departures and Profile as tabs with icons; Log in and a sheet's main button filled where the app draws them; a sheet's heading as its title; the departures search in the app's words.

packs.name: MitID
packs.description: MitID's own colours (its blue, white, navy and greys), small corners, a plain header and outlined cards; its ready and PIN screens in its blue; close, help, menu and next icons, menu rows with their lines, info boxes as notes, the approve card; every screen secure; codes as masked dots; the approve slider as a slide (touch); On the phone where it scans a passport or asks for a fingerprint.

packs.name: Rejsekort
packs.description: Rejsekort's colours in light and dark (its blue header band, white pages and charcoal text), round buttons and flat sections; Continue filled where the app draws it, on the welcome page, at the end of its guide to travelling with the app and on the location screen.

packs.name: NightPay
packs.description: NightPay's own colours: white words and round white buttons on its blue, in light and dark, a plain header and outlined cards. The welcome and log-in screens named, its logo as a picture where the owner shows what Relaid cannot read, its white pills filled where it draws them, and its unnamed MobilePay and Google log-in buttons named and filled there. Its MobilePay buttons said to use another app.
